title: NTA CSIR UGC NET June Admit Card 2026
vacancyDetails: Admit card for Joint CSIR-UGC NET June 2026 examination for Junior Research Fellowship and Lectureship/Assistant Professor
qualification: M.Sc. or equivalent degree as per CSIR-UGC NET eligibility
ageLimit: JRF age limit as per NTA notice; no upper age for Lectureship (as applicable)
applicationFee: As per NTA CSIR NET fee structure
selectionProcess: Computer Based Test → Result / Eligibility for JRF & Assistant Professor
documentsRequired: Application Number and Password; printed admit card; photo ID
howToApply:
1. Visit https://csirnet.nta.nic.in
2. Click Admit Card for Joint CSIR-UGC NET June 2026
3. Login with Application Number and Password
4. Download and print admit card
5. Appear for exam on 17-18 July 2026 as scheduled
shortDescription: NTA CSIR UGC NET June 2026 Admit Card released on 13 July for exam on 17-18 July 2026. Download from csirnet.nta.nic.in.
content:
National Testing Agency (NTA) has released the admit card for Joint CSIR-UGC NET June 2026 on 13 July 2026.

Examination dates: 17–18 July 2026. Candidates can download hall tickets from csirnet.nta.nic.in using Application Number and Password.

  • Carry printed admit card and original photo ID
  • Check subject, shift and centre carefully
  • City intimation was issued earlier for planning
